checks.name: policy allowlist reconnaissance
checks.summary: Prysm permits labelled controlled gateway TCP/UDP 13000 and TCP 443; Nethermind permits the same paths on TCP/UDP 30303 and TCP 443. Both retain DNS-only access to kube-system.

checks.name: Prysm controlled-egress dataplane test
checks.summary: The labelled Prysm probe resolved cluster DNS and reached only the controlled gateway on TCP/UDP 13000 and TCP 443. TCP 30303 and external TCP 443 were denied.

checks.name: Nethermind controlled-egress dataplane test
checks.summary: The labelled Nethermind probe resolved cluster DNS and reached only the controlled gateway on TCP/UDP 30303 and TCP 443. TCP 13000 and external TCP 443 were denied.

checks.name: fixture cleanup
checks.summary: The test initiates deletion of both fixture namespaces; integration subsequently confirmed both namespaces no longer exist. No node client was run.

checks.name: explicit limits
